title: What Scripture Actually Means When It Says Judge Not
caption:
Scripture never told you to go easy on yourself. It told you to go harder on you and softer on them.

Most guys read "judge not" as permission to stop checking themselves. Jesus said it about a man ignoring the log in his own eye, not a man who was done being examined. Rip your own sin out with both hands before you comment on his. The mercy you keep refusing to give yourself, you actually owe your brother.

Where have you been harder on him than you've ever been on you?

theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
